keyword_rules.title: Possible tampering
keyword_rules.message: Take the device out of service, do not touch anything else, photograph it and call security.

keyword_rules.title: Encryption keys
keyword_rules.message: Key faults are handled only by the key custodian. Do not reboot repeatedly or reload keys yourself.

keyword_rules.title: Cash discrepancy
keyword_rules.message: Keep the device out of service, record the difference with the second person and escalate to cash operations.

keyword_rules.title: Two-person control
keyword_rules.message: Cash and safe work needs two authorised people. Never work alone.
